inputs.label: The Simpsons: Hit & Run (original PC release)
inputs.help: The folder of your original, unmodded PC install of The Simpsons: Hit & Run (2003).

steps.text: Open The Simpsons: Hit & Run VR from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: The guide copies the complete install, so the push takes every file. The game is not sold on Steam or GOG, so stores is empty. The payload lists /sdcard/SHAR/ as another accepted folder. The payload version is v1.2; the GitHub tag is 1.2.
